action: EVT Level 1 final module nearly complete; fleet operator cold call using Carlos's name succeeds; Zoe Martinez exchange yields RoboRide intel; welcomed transferred technician
narrative: Sarah completed the integrated systems module content and shifted into assessment prep, bringing EVT Level 1 to approximately 68% — the certification assessment is now the only remaining step and she can credibly tell anyone that it is weeks away, not months. The fleet operator call using Carlos's name landed well: the contact at Millfield Regional Fleet Service spent 22 minutes with her, confirmed they do hire EVT Level 1-certified techs for entry diagnostic roles, and said to follow up when the cert is in hand. Zoe confirmed that RoboRide's delivery partner onboarding asks about vehicle maintenance access but does not yet have a regional service partnership — information Sarah filed as a future signal. She introduced herself to one of the transferred technicians, a woman named Diane who had been standing at the edge of the break room, and showed her where the supply cabinet was — a small thing that cost nothing.
